subtitle: The three commands you'll use every single day

code:
$ git status
On branch main

Untracked files:
  customer_ltv.sql

nothing added to commit
caption: A new file is untracked — Git sees it, but isn't watching it yet.

code:
$ git add customer_ltv.sql
$ git status

Changes to be committed:
  new file: customer_ltv.sql
caption: Staging is deliberate — you choose exactly what goes in next.

code:
$ git commit -m "Add customer_ltv model"
[main a1b2c3d] Add customer_ltv model

$ git log --oneline
a1b2c3d Add customer_ltv model
caption: A permanent, timestamped, attributed snapshot of what was staged.
